Understanding Neural Network Quantization

By Marcus Vance

Quantization reduces the precision of weights and activation tensors from 32-bit floating point down to 8-bit or 4-bit integers, drastically lowering memory footprint and energy consumption on mobile edge devices.

Recent advances in post-training quantization (PTQ) and quantization-aware training (QAT) allow compact models like Gemma and LLaMA to run on on-device accelerators without significant degradation in perplexity.

Compression without sacrifice is the cornerstone of edge intelligence.
